source: Real Spring Boot/MyBatis/MySQL and HTTP MCP; isolated synthetic accounts and questionnaires. No existing real questionnaires changed.

checks.name: MCP exposes all ten scoped query and preview tools, with no model confirmation tool
hello and permissions work without selecting a questionnaire
CREATE returns a persisted preview, and a model-level confirmed flag is rejected
another owner cannot confirm the preview
concurrent confirmation creates one questionnaire and replays one result
cancelled rename is durable and cannot later be confirmed
confirmed rename and description persist in MySQL
a stale preview is rejected rather than overwriting newer edits
details read real draft question content without requiring publication
single-question chat edit prepares a preview and preserves other question fields
actual model adds a validated optional question through a confirmed action
chat moves a question and removes only the selected draft question
COPY preview creates a draft with identical questions, no versions or answers
PUBLISH confirmation creates one immutable version even under concurrent clicks
active collection rejects editing previews and does not alter the published version
STOP closes the published version and sharing reports its stopped state
editing a stopped draft keeps the historical snapshot unchanged
version statistics and daily chart series match the known synthetic four-response fixture
CSV export returns all selected-version answers without IP, browser or account metadata
all new tools enforce ownership, including drafts, share links, exports and proposals
MCP cannot execute a proposal by adding a pretend confirmation argument or tool
ARCHIVE requires confirmation, preserves versions and removes the form from active searches
actual design model returns a validated unsaved draft and records its model identity
